body:
well I have been stuggling with lyme disease and other problems for 3 months and I decided to go get some shrooms and trip in my room one night. I ordered an 1/8 and got them quite soon actually. first of all I have been sick for the last 3 months so this decision was most likely the worst one of my life. I have tripped twice ( 1 with friends, 1 by myself ) before and it was absolutely amazing just laughing with my friends and seeing faces in trees and leaves smile at me.
You have to make sure that you are completely healthy before tripping because I couldn't stand or walk (no joke). I first came up all happy and seeing strange figures on my computer screen adn that was sweet but then like an hour into I literally died. im most likely sure that it was my illness not the shrooms. I tried to stand in my room in the dark and I physically could not do so.
